summary: TeeBox security-audit remediation validated end-to-end. All 28 pytest cases pass (SEC-001..005 + regressions). Frontend regressions verified via Playwright on mobile viewport: sign-in with reese@teebox.demo works, Feed renders, Post Detail comments incl. @mentions work, Course Detail shows star picker + filter chips + all-rounds + reviews, Discover shows master courses with city/region. SEC-005 also verified directly (POST /api/seed returns 404 with ENABLE_DEMO_SEED=false via in-process TestClient).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: emitted from RN Web on / and /sign-in screens.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Reference: emitted after Sign in click.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate remaining shadow* / pointerEvents style props to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 guard correctly refuses boot on short/placeholder secrets (verified by dynamic re-import).
SEC-002: enrich_round/get_comments/get_reviews/discover_users/get_user all project out email; /auth/me still returns caller's own email as expected.
SEC-003: photos truncated to first 3 (photos[:MAX_PHOTOS_PER_ROUND]); oversized photo -> 413; non-image data URI -> 415; oversized avatar in PATCH /auth/me -> 413.
SEC-004: _safe_query escapes . * + ? ^ $ { } ( ) | [ ] \ and truncates to 60 chars before $regex. Verified '.*' returns [] for both /discover/users and /discover/courses.
SEC-005: POST /api/seed returns 404 when ENABLE_DEMO_SEED=false; startup auto-seed also gated. With flag=true, endpoint idempotent (returns seeded:false when users exist).
server.py is 794 lines — over 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/ per resource in a future refactor (non-blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (sign-in, feed, discover-golfers, discover-courses, course-detail, post-detail w/ comments)

seed_data_creation: No new seed. Existing dev auto-seed (ENABLE_DEMO_SEED=true) still populates demo users/rounds/courses. Test data (TEST_* rounds/reviews/user) created during pytest — most transient rounds deleted; a few TEST_review_course reviews and one TEST_ user remain but are prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001..005 all pass. Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_security_audit.py (28 cases, ~4s). Run: EXPO_BACKEND_URL=<public-url> pytest backend/tests/test_security_audit.py -v. Note: TestSEC001 dynamically re-imports server.py with bad JWT_SECRET_KEY — it restores the original env after the test, but if you add tests that also touch sys.modules['server'], run those first.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial test failures were bugs in the test itself: (1) EmailStr rejected the reserved '.test' TLD, changed to '.dev'. (2) The 4.63 rating expectation was mathematically wrong — round(4.63*4)=19 → 4.75, not 4.5; changed input to 4.6 which correctly rounds to 4.5.
